config.source_preparation: Five independently initialized ordinary sources, 500 epochs each, followed by 900 epochs of correct forward-only single-generator preparation per source. Fresh shared source corpus and a separate paired support pool per source. Freeze encoder, both original operator maps and readout before all four first-operator arms. Only new checkpoints, never reuse previous source weights.
config.protocol_harmonization: Declared before training: all four first-operator arms use zero weight decay, so same-budget factorized training and direct affine convergence solve the same unregularized KD+normalized-MSE data objective. Source preparation retains its historical optimizer. Previous nonzero-decay studies are immutable and separately described.
config.loss: Correct fixed first-generator teacher logits for every arm; only correct versus matched-wrong first-state geometric target changes. Geometry uses fixed correct-target population variance. No composite supervision or compound-based checkpoint/hyperparameter selection.
config.test_novelty: New common test excludes every historical examined test orbit above. All new source, validation, fit and test whole-group orbits disjoint within this study. New training may reuse historical test/training orbits under entirely new initialized models, because the finite world cannot exclude all prior test orbits from every partition while retaining the fixed sample sizes. No all-history never-seen-training claim.
config.solver_policy: Float64 SVD-whitened affine function family. Its readout-null component has the exact least-squares solution, and the readout-row component solves exactly the shared correct-teacher KD+0.25 normalized MSE objective. Both starting points are fixed before new training. Original 2000-step Identity arms retain exactly the same data loss and no decay. No ridge or new objective selected. Certify each of twenty fits using strong convexity and independent analytic gradients; report convergence failures without seed replacement.
config.precision_checks: For each affine solution compare float64 and float32 inference with the same frozen second map/readout; compare independent solver starting points, coefficient norms, condition numbers, objective values and heldout state predictions. Every calculation uses the same affine function family and fixed loss.
config.test_policy: Finish all five source preparations, all twenty fixed-budget arms and all twenty convex solves before any compound inference. No early stopping or compound-based tuning. Failed primitive gates are retained and disclosed.
config.uncertainty: Paired crossed bootstrap of five source clusters and 128 common collision pairs. Report every source and distinguish individual hypotheses; no replicate count inflated by models, steps or endpoints. Intervals descriptive; no equivalence claim from crossing zero.
config.ending_rule: After this fixed five-source confirmation and the declared convergence/precision checks complete, close experimental scope regardless of significance. Integrate supported findings into the manuscript and unresolved optimization/numerical/expressivity explanations into limitations. No new domains, seeds, coefficients or mechanistic training interventions in this round.
config.scope: Correctness interventions and predicted null-component transfer conditional on relation-prepared encoders. Not spontaneous algebra discovery, no universal output-independent mechanism, no exact percentage attribution to optimization versus expressivity.
